en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the confetti of the sugar and the hazel-nuts, and its like, is it Permissible to eat it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is disliked to eat what is seized’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would prohibit utilization of walnuts, that children bring after using in gambling, saying that it is Suht (filthy), unlawful.’”
